tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and recalled note make endogenous reversal plausible, but the existing observations only cover H=0.16–0.48, far short of the target horizon. A slow-horizon discriminating observation is needed to resolve whether the response reverses before forecasting.

considered_alternatives.option: Author the dual-horizon endogenous adaptation model from the short-window rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five rows are short-horizon and show positive gain, so they do not identify the long-horizon reversal behavior needed to forecast at H=24.3.
More fine-grained short-window data would not resolve the key long-horizon ambiguity.
It is irrelevant to distinguishing the candidate mechanisms and is explicitly not worth acquiring.
